Taylor: Hey team — heads up I need to swap part of my holiday evening oncall (Dec 24, 18:00-02:00 UTC). I can cover 18:00-21:00 but my flight leaves early so I need someone to take 21:00-02:00. :airplane:
Raj: I can pick up 21:00-02:00, no prob. Any risks I should watch for?
Taylor: Thanks! Two notes: 1) We have a canary cache warmup scheduled at ~20:00 (it's a small perf job that stops cold-starts). It should be fine but if it spikes QPS you might see transient throttles. 2) There is a deploy window for a routing tweak at 23:00 in us-east (low-risk). Both are in the runbook.
Maya: Ping me if the warmup starts failing, I can shadow for 20:00-21:30. Also FYI if you take the handoff, please leave the `cache-warmup` job in running state (see command below).
Taylor: Exact commands I used to kick the warmup (from the runbook):
```
# run from infra box
./infra/run_cache_warmup.sh --env=prod --region=us-east --canary=true
# check logs
tail -f /var/log/cache-warmup.log | grep -i error
```
If you see repeated 5xx from /inference/cache-hit we should abort and escalate.
Raj: Got it. Quick Q: if the warmup spikes latency should I fallback to the previous model variant or flip routing? What's the preferred order?
Alex: Preferred order is 1) pause warmup, 2) enable fallback routing to model-v1-fallback, 3) open a zoom if it persists. I've posted the short checklist in the deployment ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123
Raj: Thanks Alex. I'll take 21:00-02:00 and will pause warmup if tail latency >250ms for 5m. I'll post handoff when Taylor signs out.
Taylor: Perfect. Leaving notes in the rota: "Taylor covers 18:00-21:00 (flight), Raj covers 21:00-02:00. Watch canary warmup at 20:00; pause if >250ms sustained; routing fallback = model-v1-fallback; deploy INF-4123 at 23:00 low-risk."
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall shift change detected for Dec 24 — please confirm handoff within the next hour. :robot_face:
Maya: Confirmed I'll be available to shadow 20:00-21:30. Add me to the pager escalation if needed.
Raj: Handed off to me at 20:58 — verified cache-warmup started and no errors. Taking full 21:00-02:00 coverage.
Taylor: Thanks Raj, Maya. Safe travels — I'll DM the boarding ETA. :thumbsup:
